annualLeave.payoutCapHours.fortyHour.label: Annual leave paid at separation, 40-hour employee
annualLeave.payoutCapHours.fortyHour.unit: hours at the regular hourly rate

annualLeave.payoutCapHours.fireSuppressi.label: Annual leave paid at separation, fire suppression
annualLeave.payoutCapHours.fireSuppressi.unit: hours: the manual says 'the equivalent for fire suppression employees' of 260 hours; 260 x 2,912 / 2,080 = 364. Confirm with Human Resources

holidayLeave.payoutCapHours.fortyHour.label: Holiday leave paid at separation, 40-hour employee
holidayLeave.payoutCapHours.fortyHour.unit: hours of frozen and/or accrued holiday leave

holidayLeave.payoutCapHours.fireSuppress.label: Holiday leave paid at separation, fire suppression
holidayLeave.payoutCapHours.fireSuppress.unit: hours of frozen and/or accrued holiday leave

compTime.maxHours.fortyHour.label: Most compensatory time a non-exempt 40-hour employee can hold
compTime.maxHours.fortyHour.unit: hours; the app assumes the balance is paid at separation at the regular hourly rate (confirm with Human Resources)

compTime.maxHours.fireSuppression.label: Most compensatory time non-exempt fire suppression can hold
compTime.maxHours.fireSuppression.unit: hours; the app assumes the balance is paid at separation at the regular hourly rate (confirm with Human Resources)

leave.payoutRate.label: Payout rate for annual, holiday and compensatory leave
leave.payoutRate.unit: share of the regular hourly rate (100%, per user); sick leave is paid at 50% under 10.7(H)

deferral.limit.label: 457(b) elective deferral limit
deferral.limit.unit: dollars per calendar year; later years grow with inflation in $500 steps (estimate)

deferral.catchUp50.label: Age 50 catch-up (governmental 457(b))
deferral.catchUp50.unit: dollars per calendar year, for people 50 or older by December 31

deferral.catchUp60to63.label: Catch-up for ages 60 to 63
deferral.catchUp60to63.unit: dollars per calendar year, replacing the age 50 amount for people who turn 60, 61, 62 or 63 that year, if the plan allows

deferral.rothCatchUpWageThreshold.label: Roth catch-up wage threshold
deferral.rothCatchUpWageThreshold.unit: prior-year Social Security (FICA) wages; above it, age-based catch-ups must be Roth

deferral.specialCatchUp.label: 457(b) special catch-up, last 3 years before normal retirement age
deferral.specialCatchUp.unit: times the yearly limit at most, or the limit plus unused limit from earlier years, whichever is less. It cannot be used in the same year as the age-based catch-up; the larger one applies
deferral.specialCatchUp.citation: Issue Snapshot: 457(b) catch-up contributions; Treas. Reg. 1.457-4(c)(2)

deferral.postSeverance.label: Deferring leave paid at retirement
deferral.postSeverance.value: allowed by IRS rules if the plan permits
deferral.postSeverance.unit: unused bona fide sick, vacation or other leave the employee could have used, paid by the later of 2½ months after separation or the end of that calendar year; counts toward the year's limit. Confirm your plan allows it
deferral.postSeverance.citation: 26 CFR 1.415(c)-2(e)(3), as summarized by the Minnesota State Retirement System
